name: Low Density Polyethylene
description: Flexible film with good moisture barrier and heat sealability. Widely used for fresh produce overwrap and frozen food bags.

name: High Density Polyethylene
avoid_for: Fresh produce requiring gas exchange,High respiration fruits
description: Rigid to semi-rigid packaging with excellent moisture barrier. Used for bottles, containers and films for dairy.

name: Polypropylene
avoid_for: High moisture fresh produce,Long shelf-life fresh meat
description: Good clarity, high stiffness and excellent moisture barrier. Used for snack packaging and ready meal trays.

name: Polyethylene Terephthalate
avoid_for: Highly respiring fresh produce,Frozen foods requiring flexibility
description: Excellent gas barrier and clarity. Ideal for products needing oxygen exclusion. Commonly used for beverage bottles and food trays.

name: Biaxially Oriented PP
description: High clarity, good stiffness and excellent moisture barrier. Most common snack food packaging film.

name: Metallized BOPP
description: Metallized film with excellent barrier against moisture, oxygen and light. Premium look for dry food snacks.

name: Aluminum Foil Laminate
description: Near-zero permeability to gases and moisture. Used for ultra-long shelf-life products and retort processing. Best barrier available.

name: EVOH Multilayer Film
description: Ethylene vinyl alcohol co-polymer with outstanding oxygen barrier. Used in multilayer structures for MAP and premium food packaging.

name: Polyamide Nylon
description: Good oxygen barrier with excellent puncture resistance. Ideal for vacuum-packed fresh meat and thermoformed trays.

name: Polylactic Acid Film
description: Compostable bioplastic from corn starch. Good clarity and moderate barrier for short shelf-life fresh products.

name: Cellulose Based Film
avoid_for: Products needing strong moisture barrier,Frozen foods
description: Plant-based transparent film with good gas exchange. Biodegradable alternative for fresh produce and bakery.

name: Starch Blend Film
description: Thermoplastic starch blended film. Most affordable biodegradable option for farmers markets and local fresh produce.

name: Micro-perforated PP
description: Laser-perforated PP film that allows controlled gas exchange for high-respiration fresh produce. Prevents anaerobic conditions.

name: Anti-fog PP Film
description: PP film with anti-fog coating to prevent condensation inside pack. Used for fresh cut produce retail packaging.

name: Vacuum Skin Pack Film
description: Tight-fitting skin pack film for premium protein products. Extends shelf life and provides superior presentation.

name: WAXED Paper
description: Traditional wax-coated paper for bakery and deli use. Biodegradable and suitable for short shelf-life items.

name: Kraft Paper Bag
description: Breathable, strong paper packaging ideal for bulky root vegetables and dry commodities sold at market.

name: Jute Mesh Bag
description: Natural highly breathable packaging for robust root vegetables and tubers. Ideal for farmer-to-market transport.

name: Modified Atmosphere Bag MAP-PP
description: Pre-gassed bags with nitrogen/CO2 flush for protein and ready-meal shelf life extension. Requires gas flushing equipment.

name: Silica Gel + LDPE Combo
description: LDPE bag with integrated silica gel desiccant for moisture-sensitive dry products. Prevents caking and mold growth.
